description: This source file defines a utility for creating and managing a network discovery browser using Apple's Network framework. It provides a single public method to instantiate and configure an NWBrowser for Bonjour (ZeroConf) service discovery, with asynchronous handling of state changes and discovered results.

methods.name: makeBrowser
methods.description: Creates and configures an NWBrowser instance for Bonjour service discovery with specified parameters and callback handlers.
